'''R2-D1''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]]. Active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], R2-D1 served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] aboard their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="SW" />
